name: Ghriba
description: Crumbly almond or sesame shortbread cookies with a cracked sugar crust that melt in the mouth.
ingredients: a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
a generous spoonful of orange blossom water
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with butter.
In a large bowl, whisk together the crusty bread and saffron threads until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the honey with the chicken stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 15 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with cilantro or a dusting of dried apricots.
Slice or portion into servings and serve.
tips: For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
Bring your honey to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
